resumeText:
Sneha Raghavan | Bengaluru | sneha.raghavan@example.com

EXPERIENCE
RFIC Design Engineer, Kaveri Silicon Labs, Bengaluru (2022 - present)
- Designed a 2.4 GHz LNA and down-conversion mixer for a Wi-Fi 6 receiver in 28nm CMOS.
- Met a 2.1 dB noise figure and +5 dBm IIP3 target across PVT corners and Monte Carlo runs.
- Ran Cadence Spectre and SpectreRF PSS and Pnoise simulations for the full receiver chain.
- Modelled on-chip inductors and baluns in EMX and used the models in schematic simulation.
- Ran post-layout extraction with Quantus and fixed gain and match shifts with the layout team.
- Wrote Python scripts to automate corner sweeps and plot results.

Analog Design Engineer, Nandi Microsystems, Bengaluru (2020 - 2022)
- Designed a bandgap reference and LDO for a sensor interface chip.
- Supported tape-out checks for two mixed-signal test chips.

EDUCATION
MTech VLSI Design, NIT Tiruchirappalli, 2020

SKILLS
Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre, SpectreRF, EMX, Spectrum analyzer, Python
